title: Mirror WorkOS data into Postgres
description: Backfill WorkOS data, poll the Events API, and reconcile drift on a schedule. A WorkOS webhook triggers an immediate poll. Join users, organizations, and memberships in SQL.

environment.name: WORKOS_API_KEY
environment.description: The secret API key, starting with sk_, for the WorkOS environment to mirror. Create it under API Keys in the WorkOS Dashboard.

environment.name: WORKOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environment.description: The signing secret of the WorkOS webhook endpoint that points at this function's /webhook route. Any placeholder works until the endpoint exists.

environment.name: WORKOS_SYNC_STATUS_TOKEN
environment.description: GET /status requires this bearer token because function URLs are public. Use any long random string, for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`.
